thread:
maya: quick alert 11 noticed an odd dip in MQL conversion this morning. overall sessions are up but MQLs down ~28%. anyone see this on the pulseboard?

leo: i'm on it. preliminary UTM slice shows a lot of traffic from the new launch post tagged `utm_campaign=launch_oct` and `utm_medium=paid_social`. conversion from that cohort is unusually low.

sam: could be an instrumentation hiccup on the webhook side. we had a minor deploy around 02:00 UTC. tagging infra.

analytics-bot: funnel_v3 snapshot | sessions 108,412 (+22%) | MQL 2,840 (-28%) | SQL 1,120 (-25%)  2050012345 08:04 UTC

olivia: routing rules unchanged since last week. we added a quick opt-prioritization for enterprise leads yesterday but that shouldn't alter MQL flags. i'll pull routing logs for the suspect window.

natalie: heads-up: if ingestion lost events, our week-over-week KPI slides will be skewed. i'll mark the Friday review as tentative until we confirm.

maya: please pull a 200-lead sample from the `paid_social` utm_medium with all attribution fields and routing_decision. want to see if leads were created but lost MQL events.

leo: SQL i' m running this query now:
```sql
SELECT id, created_at, utm_campaign, utm_medium, mql_event_received, routing_queue
FROM leads_events_v2
WHERE created_at >= '2024-10-12' AND utm_medium = 'paid_social'
ORDER BY created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
```

sam: confirmed: a consumer restarted during the 02:00-02:45 UTC window; estimated event loss ~15-20%. opened ticket MK-621. replay queued.

olivia: routing logs for that window show no anomalous reroutes. forwarding audit CSV to this thread.

analytics-bot: note added to dashboard: "ingestion anomaly detected 2024-10-12 02:00-02:45 UTC. counts may be underreported."  2050012460 08:21 UTC

natalie: i'll prepare two versions of the KPI slide: raw and ingestion-adjusted (reconciled). will include both last-touch and multi-touch attribution to highlight differences.

maya: good. action list: sam = confirm replay and reconciliation numbers, leo = add ingestion annotation + both attribution models on the funnel dashboard, natalie = update Friday KPI deck with adjusted figures and notes, olivia = attach routing audit file. pls update when done. :white_check_mark:

sam: replay finished, reconciliation job running now. ETA results 10h.

leo: pushed annotation to pulseboard and added a multi-touch toggle for the campaign line. internal link: https://pulse.redwood.ai/dashboards/funnels (internal)

natalie: draft slide is in the deck under "weeklies/oct-12"; flagged the numbers as provisional pending reconciliation.

maya: thanks team. once reconciliation completes we'll decide whether to exclude that ingestion window from the month-over-month comparisons. will circle back in the Friday KPI huddle.
